title: The canonical coefficient-complex cocone is a colimit
statement: With the constructions of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-coefficient-complex-diagram], for every scheme X, prime ℓ, finite coefficient fields E,F, arbitrary F_X-module cochain complex C, small filtered category I, final H:I→FiniteIntermediateField(ℓ), and bounds E≤H(i), F≤H(i), the specified coefficientComplexCocone is a colimit cocone.

source.place: ExtendScalars and Constructible sections (boundedConstructible_derivedExtendScalarsSubfield_obj, boundedConstructible_derivedExtendScalarsToPadicAlgCl_obj), and TwoColimit section (constructibleCocone_essSurjObj, constructibleCocone_homSurj, constructibleCocone_homInj, constructibleCocone_isFilteredTwoColimit); these are unproved upstream inputs

proof.text: Whisker the proved coefficient-ring colimit with the final functor H. Tensor once or twice with a fixed underlying complex term; these functors preserve colimits.

The two action arrows defining balanced scalar extension are compatible with the ring-inclusion legs. Descend the universal map from the ordinary tensor colimit through the vertex coequalizer. Epimorphy of each stage coequalizer proves the cocone equations, and epimorphy of the vertex coequalizer plus the tensor colimit universal property proves uniqueness.
Apply this construction in every degree, reflect the colimit along the underlying-module functor, and use HomologicalComplex.isColimitOfEval to obtain the complex colimit.

theorem nonempty_isColimit_coefficientComplexCocone
    {E F : FiniteIntermediateField ℓ}
    (C : CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicSubfieldRingObj X ℓ F)) ℤ)
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (H : I ⥤ FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) [H.Final]
    (he : ∀ i, E ≤ H.obj i) (hf : ∀ i, F ≤ H.obj i) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (coefficientComplexCocone X ℓ C H he hf))
